2610.13207.title: SharP: Soft and Hard Prompt-Guided Augmentation with LLM for Low Resource Fake News Detection
2610.13207.paper_summary: Fake news detection under low resource conditions is challenged by the scarcity of labeled data and the difficulty of capturing subtle deceptive patterns. In this work, we focus on low resource fake news detection, where only a small labeled set is available for training, while evaluation is performed under a fixed and unchanged test protocol. This setting is motivated by costly, ambiguous fact-checking and emerging topics and domains that are poorly covered by existing benchmarks. Existing data augmentation methods, such as synonym substitution, generative adversarial networks, and large language model (LLM)-based generation, often produce fluent but overly generic content, lacking the task-specific relevance needed for accurate detection. To address this, we propose SharP, a boundary-aware text generation framework guided by soft and hard prompts, which leverages LLMs as tools adapted to produce task-specific synthetic samples. SharP employs a dual prompt mechanism: hard prompts provide structured guidance and factual constraints, while soft prompts introduce learned semantic patterns from the data. These two types of prompts are combined to guide the generation process, enabling the model to produce samples that closely align with the characteristics of news. To further enhance detection performance, we incorporate a boundary-aware strategy that steers generation toward areas where the classifier is less confident, helping to clarify subtle distinctions between real and fake content. In addition, we adopt a dual objective optimization that balances semantic alignment with the source data and classifier feedback. This encourages the generation of samples that are both domain-consistent and helpful for refining decision boundaries, ultimately improving model robustness and generalization in low resource fake news detection.
2610.13207.paper_summary_zh: 假新聞檢測在低資源條件下面臨標記數據稀缺和捕捉微妙欺騙模式的困難。在本研究中，我們專注於低資源假新聞檢測，其中僅有少量標記集可用於訓練，而評估則在固定且不變的測試協議下進行。這一設置受到昂貴且模糊的事實檢查以及現有基準中覆蓋不充分的新興主題和領域的驅動。現有的數據增強方法，如同義詞替換、生成對抗網絡和基於大型語言模型（LLM）的生成，通常產生流暢但過於通用的內容，缺乏準確檢測所需的任務特定相關性。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了SharP，一個邊界感知的文本生成框架，通過軟提示和硬提示進行引導，利用LLM作為工具來生成任務特定的合成樣本。SharP採用雙提示機制：硬提示提供結構化指導和事實約束，而軟提示則從數據中引入學習到的語義模式。這兩種類型的提示結合在一起，引導生成過程，使模型能夠生成與新聞特徵密切對齊的樣本。為了進一步提高檢測性能，我們採用了邊界感知策略，將生成引導到分類器信心較低的區域，幫助澄清真實內容和假內容之間的微妙區別。此外，我們採用雙目標優化，平衡與源數據和分類器反饋的語義對齊。這鼓勵生成既與領域一致又有助於完善決策邊界的樣本，最終提高模型在低資源假新聞檢測中的穩健性和泛化能力。
